name: Repair without regression
when: An edit has addressed a violation but may have affected neighboring constraints.
procedure: Reinspect the original conflict in the updated observations.
Check nearby objects and boundaries that could be affected by the edited pose.
If a new violation appears, reconsider the transformation rather than treating the original repair as complete.
verification: The original conflict is resolved and no new relevant violation is evident in available observations.
failure_lessons: A locally successful correction can make the overall scene invalid.
adaptation_notes: Original verification procedure tailored to scene repair; no private collision oracle.
